name: transition
description: Shorthand that animates a CSS property smoothly from its old value to its new value over a given duration.
notes: The animated property must change value (e.g. via :hover or a class toggle) for the transition to run.

name: transition-property
description: Specifies which CSS property (or properties) a transition applies to.

name: transition-duration
description: Sets how long a transition takes to complete.

name: transition-timing-function
syntax: transition-timing-function: ease | linear | ease-in | ease-out | ease-in-out | cubic-bezier(...);
description: Sets the acceleration curve of a transition over its duration.

name: transition-delay
description: Sets how long to wait before a transition starts after the property change is triggered.

name: @keyframes
description: Defines a named sequence of style states an element passes through during an animation.
notes: A defined @keyframes rule does nothing on its own — it must be referenced by the animation-name/animation property.

name: animation
syntax: animation: name duration timing-function delay iteration-count direction fill-mode;
description: Shorthand for applying a @keyframes animation to an element, combining its timing, iteration, and fill behavior.

name: animation-iteration-count
description: Sets how many times an animation cycle repeats before stopping.

name: animation-fill-mode
description: Determines what styles apply to an element before the animation starts and after it ends.
notes: forwards keeps the last keyframe's styles applied after the animation finishes — otherwise it reverts to the original styles.

name: animation-play-state
description: Pauses or resumes a running animation without removing it.

name: transform
description: Applies 2D or 3D transformations, such as moving, rotating, scaling, or skewing, to an element without affecting document flow.
notes: transform is a common property to animate because browsers can render it efficiently on the GPU, unlike top/left.

name: translate()
description: Moves an element along the X and/or Y axis relative to its current position, without affecting layout flow.
notes: Commonly combined with position: absolute and top/left: 50% to perfectly center an element.

name: rotate()
description: Rotates an element around a fixed point (its transform-origin) by a given angle.

name: scale()
description: Resizes an element along the X and/or Y axis by a given multiplier.
